Resolves #20373

Related: #20370

Adds `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` to lock the six off-socket Neural Link dispatch invariants across `Neo.ai.Client#handleTestRequest` and the dedicated App Worker adapter (`runDedicatedWorkerNeuralLink` / `createDedicatedWorkerAppConnection`), with a control in each spec that fires when its guard is bypassed.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit suite executes in CI against live `Neo.ai.Client`, `WriteGuard`, `TransactionService`, and the six hosted client services in the same test realm) → L1 required (AC-1 through AC-6 are unit-level dispatch, guard, conflict, lifetime, and parity invariants).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `pr-body` and pre-commit hooks ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` (`Refusal: an incomplete writer pair is refused before dispatch, and no write lands; control dispatches when the entry gate is bypassed`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` — representative reads and writes across all six hosted services (`ComponentService`, `DataService`, `DockService`, `InstanceService`, `InteractionService`, `RuntimeService`), including existing enforced write/undo paths (`set_instance_properties`, `create_instance` + `undo`), record zero socket reads on a trapped socket; live trap control fires when `client.isConnected` is read and `client.sendNotification('trap_probe', {})` is called. |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` (`Identical off-socket: the five write calls in the suite census produce identical result, state and transaction stack through an agent_message frame and through the test entry; control detects a divergent envelope`) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` (`Two-pair conflict: while pair A holds a subtree lock, pair B overlapping write is denied; control grants after pair A releases`) |
| AC-5 | `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` (`Lifetime: test A writes and throws; after fixture cleanup, test B fresh pair meets no stale conflict and inherits no undo stack; control conflicts when cleanup is skipped`) |
| AC-6 | `test/playwright/unit/ai/ClientOffSocketDispatch.spec.mjs` (`No denylist: focus_window on an unknown id refuses off-socket exactly as on-socket with no native focus call; control invokes windowNativeFocus for a known routable window`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- **AC-2 (`No socket reads` / `D#18775` OQ1 contract accuracy):** In `D#18775` OQ1 and its context/lifetime fold, existing service undo semantics are preserved without inventing new per-service undo features (`InstanceService` `set_instance_properties` / `create_instance` record undo frames executed via `undo`; `DockService` lines 715–745 take the legacy-holder branch when the holder lacks `topologyGroupId` / `workspaceSet`; `InteractionService`, `ComponentService`, `DataService`, and `RuntimeService` have no undo path). AC-2 therefore exercises representative reads and writes across all six hosted services plus the existing enforced write+undo paths over the trapped socket, with a live trap control reading `client.isConnected` and calling `client.sendNotification`.
